    def shift_back(ch):
        if 'a' <= ch <= 'z':
            return chr((ord(ch) - ord('a') - 2) % 26 + ord('a'))
        if 'A' <= ch <= 'Z':
            return chr((ord(ch) - ord('A') - 2) % 26 + ord('A'))
        return ch

    outputs = []
    for s in probe["inputs"]:
        r = s[::-1]
        if r and r[0].isalpha():
            r = shift_back(r[0]) + r[1:]
        outputs.append(r)
